args.lesson: Reusing unchanged hashes and execution receipts avoided redundant testing. description: The discovery document blurs a material specification distinction: RFC 3339 permits leap seconds, while this parser rejects them by application policy. Finish this bounded review with NEEDS_WORK and delegate only the sentence correction. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; funding and revenue remain unverified.
